title: AI companies in regulated markets do not die from lack of technology
subtitle: They die from lack of governance. Attolloo invests senior executive depth — against equity, not hourly fees.

sections.body:
Early-stage AI companies in Fintech, Regtech, and Compliance Automation face a specific, structural problem in the 12-36 months after first product launch. They have technology that works. What they lack is the governance architecture that makes banks, insurers, pension funds, and public sector organisations willing to buy it, partner with it, and fund it.

The EU AI Act entered full enforcement in August 2026. DORA has been applicable since January 2025. Compliance is no longer a future obligation — it is a present commercial condition. A founder who cannot document AI governance to a procurement committee loses the contract. A founder who cannot demonstrate regulatory readiness to an institutional investor does not close the round.

This is not a problem a lawyer and a CTO can solve alone. It requires someone who has built governance architecture from the inside — across multiple cycles of regulatory disruption, in the same sectors, with the same institutional stakeholders.
sections.heading: The Governance Gap Is Existential
Capital is Abundant. Executive Governance Depth is Not.
sections.body:
Attolloo Group AS is an asset-light venture studio. I go into early-stage AI companies in regulated sectors — not primarily with capital, but with senior executive depth: CEO governance, CSO risk architecture, and HR Director leadership — in exchange for equity stakes or performance-based revenue shares.

No hourly fees. No report delivered and forgotten. Skin in the game from day one.

The engagement is structured around four proprietary frameworks — 6Sense Filter, AI Compass, Polaris Framework, and Kando Framework — developed from forty years of operational experience in regulated markets and validated through an MBA and Master of Digital Business at Distinction level (9.7 / 10.0).

> The 6Sense Filter screens every venture before engagement begins. If your company does not pass all six dimensions, I say so — early and clearly. The filter exists to protect both parties.

sections.heading: A Proprietary Four-Framework Methodology Stack
sections.body:
Four integrated frameworks govern every Attolloo engagement, from initial qualification to operational execution:

**6Sense Filter**
Six-dimensional qualification gate. Screens for verified market demand, unit economics (CLV:CAC >= 3:1), PMF signals, operational scalability, data quality, and regulatory risk. Every venture passes all six dimensions before engagement begins.

**AI Compass**
1-to-5 star digital and organisational maturity diagnostic. Maps where a company actually is — from manual PDF workflows (1 star) to AI-driven autonomous governance (5 stars). Prescribes a sequenced path forward.

**Polaris Framework**
KPI governance and 90-day execution architecture. Tracks AOV, CLV:CAC, OEE, OTIF, CCC, and CAC Payback Period. Includes Track Synchronisation Protocol for aligning digital sprints with regulatory compliance milestones.

**Kando Framework**
Operational execution and crisis intelligence. Applies Theory of Constraints and Drum-Buffer-Rope logic to executive capacity management. Converts negative events — churn, returns, complaints — into structured strategic intelligence.

sections.heading: Led by Nils Johan Brede
sections.body:
Forty years of unbroken executive experience across five generations of technology disruption in regulated markets — from building Norway's first municipal internet portals in the late 1990s, through cybersecurity turnaround and acquisition, to Privacy Tech at European scale with GDPR and MiFID II, to current executive leadership in one of Norway's most complex regulated public institutions.

MBA + Master of Digital Business, ENEB / Universidad Isabel I — 9.7 / 10.0, Distinction. The methodology is not academic theory retrofitted to practice. It is forty years of practice, subsequently grounded and validated through seventeen graduate examination modules.
